name: Rock Garden of Chandigarh
description: Famed 40-acre sculpture garden created secretly by Nek Chand using industrial, urban and rock waste.
note: Famed 40-acre sculpture garden created secretly by Nek Chand using industrial and rock waste.
tip: Wear comfortable walking shoes for the multi-phase trail.

name: Sukhna Lake
description: A scenic 3 sq km rainfed reservoir at the foothills of the Himalayas, popular for boating and serene strolls.
note: Scenic Himalayan reservoir popular for pedal boats, morning jogs, and sunset walks.
tip: Sunset boating offers gorgeous views over the Shivalik hills.

name: Zakir Hussain Rose Garden
description: Asia's largest botanical garden dedicated to roses, spanning 30 acres with over 50,000 rose bushes of 1,600 varieties.
note: Sprawling 30-acre botanical garden showcasing over 50,000 rose bushes.
tip: Best blooming season is between late February and early March.

name: Capitol Complex (UNESCO Heritage)
description: World Heritage site featuring Le Corbusier's monumental modernist architecture, including the High Court, Secretariat, and Open Hand Monument.
note: Le Corbusier's celebrated UNESCO monument with the Open Hand sculpture.
tip: Official tourist permission/badges can be arranged at the tourist centre.

name: Government Museum and Art Gallery
description: Premier art museum housing an exquisite collection of Gandharan sculptures, Pahari miniature paintings, and modern Indian art.
note: World-class collection of Gandharan stone sculptures and Pahari miniatures.
tip: Photography permitted in select galleries; check at entrance.

name: Japanese Garden
description: Tranquil 13-acre park featuring traditional Japanese pagodas, meditation huts, Zen rock gardens, and koi ponds.
note: Peaceful 13-acre themed park with pagoda towers, Zen rock gardens, and ponds.
tip: The illuminated waterfall in the evening is popular for pictures.

name: Leisure Valley
description: An 8 km long continuous green belt running across the city designed by Le Corbusier as the lungs of Chandigarh.
note: Linear 8 km lush green valley stretching through the heart of the city.
tip: Ideal for fresh morning walks and cycling along designated paths.
